description.en: A limited edition Gunpla at the official Gunpla facility "Gundam Base" for Gunpla fans around the world.

description.en: From "Gundam Build Divers Re:RISE ", " Mobile Doll May" is now available in a refreshing blue Gundam base color!

description.ja: • ガンダムベースオリジナルのスペシャルマーキングシールが付属！

description.en: • It is possible to rearrange the MS state that Mei is piloting in GBN and her appearance in real life!

description.ja: • フェイスパーツは3種類付属。瞳はシールと水転写デカールが付属！
description.en: • Three types of face parts are included. Seals and water transfer decals are included for the eyes!

description.ja: • ポージングが決まるクリアブルーの台座が付属！
description.en: • Comes with a clear blue pedestal for easy posing!
